d:
Aditya Music presents "Laali Laali Tamil Video Song" from the movie "Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru" starring Karthi and Rakul Preet Singh. This soul-stirring melody is brought to life by the magical composition of Ghibran. With gripping visuals and powerful vocals from Sathyaprakash, Ghibran and Pragathi Guruprasad, this song will touch your heart and make you fall in love with it.
Song Credits:
Song Name : Laali Laali
Movie Name : Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru
Banner : Dream Warrior Pictures
Producers : S. R. Prakashbabu, S. R. Prabhu
Director : H.Vinoth
Starring : Karthi, Rakul Preet
